meaning:
κινδυνεύω
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;]
1. to be daring, to venture.
2. to be in danger: Luk.8:23, Act.19:27, 40, 1Co.15:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her…
Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
